hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/handoff.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then ts=$(date -r "$f" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' 2>/dev/null || stat -c %y "$f" 2>/dev/null); echo "An existing handoff.md was found for this worktree (last updated: ${ts:-unknown}). Read it now to restore context before continuing. If it predates recent commits, trust the repo over the handoff and say so:"; echo; cat "$f"; fi

input=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "kit: jq not found on PATH; transcript NOT backed up" >&2; exit 0; }; tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -n "$tp" ] && [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; gcd=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$gcd" ]; then repo=$(basename "$(dirname "$gcd")"); br=$(git -C "$p" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); br=${br:-detached}; else repo=$(basename "$p"); br=no-git; fi; br=$(printf '%s' "$br" | tr '/' '-'); d="$HOME/.claude/handoff-backups/$repo/$br"; mkdir -p "$d" || exit 0; cp "$tp" "$d/transcript-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).jsonl"; ls -t "$d"/transcript-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | tail -n +6 | while IFS= read -r old; do rm -f "$old"; done; find "$HOME/.claude/handoff-backups" -name 'transcript-*.jsonl' -type f -mtime +90 -delete 2>/dev/null; exit 0
